qualification_scope: Shared Apple host; native macOS and native-ISA ARM64 Linux Docker VM with two CPU quota; warm filesystem, fresh table/corpus and fresh predicate work per query. Nine trials per workload/control. Independent physical Linux, cold storage and fleet-wide concurrency remain outside these measurements. CPU includes background work; sampled memory is not a hard allocation bound.
allocation_fixture_note: An existing Linux allocation-failure fixture was stabilized by refusing remaps/resizes so growth always uses the counted allocation path. This test-only correction does not change production parsing. Initial nondeterministic test failure is retained locally.

initial_observations.note: The initial VM selected-string timing was variable. A fixed absolute 5% CPU settling threshold then rejected the old server with steady nonzero idle maintenance. Final protocol 4 records pre-ingestion idle CPU independently, a warmup query, and three full quiet windows relative to that baseline. Every timed query still verifies the complete corpus; no timed trials are removed.

repeated_linux_default_comparison.scope: Consecutive baseline/default invocations in one native ARM64 Linux container with a two-CPU quota; own compiler paused; all timed trials retained. Absolute VM timings varied substantially, including an unchanged tiny-source decoder control. These observations are not a physical-hardware speed guarantee.
